Original Wispbound adaptive mystical lo-fi score. No third-party samples, recordings or melodies.
Composed offline by scripts/compose-adaptive-music.py.
88 BPM, 160 arranged bars (436.36 seconds): warm electric piano, felt-key calls and soft struck-crystal replies, rootless jazz harmony, rounded bass and a swung kick/snare groove.
Ten harmonic sections alternate walking, 176-subdivision double-time motion and sparse half-time breathing spaces. Four-bar call/response phrases leave rests; fills anticipate transitions. Three equal-length stems stream as MP3s; scene changes adjust volume without synthesizing the score during gameplay. The lift guide remains a separate instrument on the shared transport.
